stud_len.reason: Stud length changes the part, so vendor price basis changes.

thread.reason: Thread size or series change needs new taps or dies and changes the stud price basis.

material.reason: Material change (e.g. A193 B7 -> A320 L7 low-temp) changes price and lead time, needs new mill certs and impact test, and may change nut/washer spec. Check nuts, washers and certs too.

spec_note.reason: Spec note change (general note) can change material, certs and test requirements even when the title block does not change.

holes.reason: Hole count change means a new bolt circle, so stud quantity (holes x joints), machining and fit change. Check stud quantity and mating parts.

qty.reason: Quantity change moves the price break.

diameter.reason: Stud diameter change means different stock and thread tooling.

nut.reason: Nut grade must match the stud spec. A nut change can need a new cert and price.

coating.reason: Coating change (zinc, PTFE) changes process and price.

nace.reason: NACE hardness requirement added or removed. Engineering must confirm sour-service compliance.

tolerance.reason: Tolerance tokens changed. Tighter tolerance can fail inspection and needs engineering review.

gdt.reason: Geometric tolerance (position, flatness, etc.) changed. Tighter value can fail inspection.

general_tol.reason: General tolerance block changed. It applies to every dimension without its own tolerance.

tubing_grade.reason: Tube grade allowance changed (ASTM A500 Grade B to Grade B or C). Affects mill certs and supplier options.
